description: An oil-style painting of an interior hall with dark carved wood pillars and gold-patterned screens. On a raised dais a bearded man in a black robe and tall black hat sits, with attendants in dark robes and hats standing beside him. In the foreground, bearded men in rough, worn cloaks and tunics kneel on a patterned carpet; one arranges large ivory tusks, and a dark horn-like object lies on the floor. A bearded man in a brown cloak on the right gestures with open hands. No visible text or frame.
